description: World - Top 70 Floating Solar PV Plants is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Solar, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Saori Minamino (World Bank Group). List of largest floating solar PV plants globally, prepared by Solarplaza and made available through Last updated November 2016 More information, and background article available at Disclaimer: This overview is provided by Solarplaza International BV ("Solarplaza") as a service to its customers on an "as-is, as-available" basis for informational purposes only. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 2 files in CSV, XLS. The portal files it under Solar, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
